import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long INFLL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;
    static final int N = 50 * T + 2;

    static class Edge {
        int v, r;
        long f, c, p;
        Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
            this.v = v; this.r = r; this.f = f; this.c = c; this.p = p;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[N];
    static int[] sz = new int[N];
    static long mc;
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
    static int[] par = new int[N];
    static long[] pot = new long[N];
    static long[] dist = new long[N];

    static void init() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        Arrays.fill(sz, 0);
        mc = 0;
    }

    static void addEdge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
        mc = Math.max(mc, c);
        adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
        adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
    }

    static void potInit(int n) {
        Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (e.c != 0) {
                        pot[e.v] = Math.min(pot[e.v], pot[u] + e.p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long minCostFlow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        dist[s] = 0;
        if (sparse) {
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] u = pq.poll();
                int uNode = (int) u[1];
                if (vis[uNode]) continue;
                vis[uNode] = true;
                for (Edge e : adj[uNode]) {
                    if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[uNode] + pot[uNode] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[uNode] + pot[uNode] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                        par[e.v] = e.r;
                        pq.offer(new long[]{-dist[e.v], e.v});
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int u = s;
            while (u != -1) {
                vis[u] = true;
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                        par[e.v] = e.r;
                    }
                }
                u = -1;
                long best = INF;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                        best = dist[i];
                        u = i;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (dist[t] >= INF) return 0;
        long df = INF;
        for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[par[u]].get(par[u]).v) {
            Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
            df = Math.min(df, adj[r.v].get(r.r).c - adj[r.v].get(r.r).f);
        }
        for (int u = t; u != s; u = adj[par[u]].get(par[u]).v) {
            Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
            Edge e = adj[r.v].get(r.r);
            e.f += df;
            adj[r.v].get(r.r).f -= df;
            price[0] += df * e.p;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (dist[i] + pot[i] < INF) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
        }
        return df;
    }

    static long minCostFlow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        long flow = 0;
        long df;
        do {
            df = minCostFlow(s, t, price, n, sparse);
            flow += df;
        } while (df > 0);
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        init();

        int n, m, k, c, d;
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            addEdge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            addEdge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    addEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    addEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    addEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = minCostFlow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        if (flow != k) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Flow does not match k");
        }
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
